annotation.title_clean: Teacher Perspectives on How To Train Your Robot: A Middle School AI and Ethics Curriculum
annotation.title_en: Teacher Perspectives on How To Train Your Robot: A Middle School AI and Ethics Curriculum
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Williams, R.; Kaputsos, S.P.; Breazeal, C.
annotation.summary_en: AAAI-21 paper describing the How to Train Your Robot middle school AI and ethics curriculum and teacher professional development, with teacher interviews before and after a five-day course. It finds that trained teachers, even those new to computer science, felt prepared and engaged students. A physical robot is used as a teaching tool.
key_provisions_or_claims: Curriculum teaches AI, machine learning and ethics to ages 11-14 over five days
Teachers new to CS felt prepared after professional development
Teachers reported students were engaged, including beyond class hours
Physical robot integrated to promote engagement through embodied interaction
Argues AI education should target public K-12 classrooms to broaden access
